name: Reverse IP Lookup
description: Identify domain names sharing the same Internet host (IP address) using the DomainTools Reverse IP API. Query an IP address to find other domains hosted on that IP. Note: Results represent a subset of domains on shared hosting for investigative use, not exhaustive enumeration. Unsuitable for large CDNs or cloud providers.

ip.description: The IP address to search for hosted domains (e.g., 199.30.228.77)

ip_addresses.description: Array of IP address objects containing domain information

domain_count.description: Total number of known domains hosted on this IP address

domain_names.description: Array of domain names hosted on this IP address
